name: Sweet Affection
source:
Sweet Affection is a game about a young man that just finished college and is now trying to figure out what he is going to do with his life.

Are you going to follow your dreams of making it big as a game developer, or are you going to try and find romance and love with one of the many ladies in town?

Or are you finally ready to listen to your heart and find love with those who are already closest to you? Join him on his romantic journey.

From [url=https://www.patreon.com/naughtyatticgaming/about]Patreon[/url]
translation:
《Sweet Affection》是一款关于一名刚刚大学毕业的年轻人正在努力弄清楚自己要做什么的游戏。

你会追随自己的梦想，成为一名游戏开发者，还是会尝试与镇上众多女士中的一位寻找浪漫和爱情？

或者你终于准备好倾听自己的内心并与那些已经最亲近的人找到爱了吗？和他一起踏上浪漫之旅。

来自 [url=https://www.patreon.com/naughtyatticgaming/about]Patreon[/url]
